title: The $33.86 Billion Financial Disaster That Shocked America! #Shorts

lines: Thirty three point eight six billion dollars in assets...
America, nineteen eighty eight. The savings and loan industry is falling apart.
It started with interest rates. They exploded to almost twenty percent!
Their old mortgages paid low, fixed rates. But savers now wanted much more. Every month, they lost money.
So many gambled. Risky loans. Empty office towers. And they lost even more.
September ninth, nineteen eighty eight. The owner of American Savings and Loan goes bankrupt.
Thirty three point eight six billion dollars in assets!
And that was just one. From eighty six to ninety five, over a thousand thrifts failed.
And the bill landed on taxpayers. About one hundred twenty four billion dollars!
Could this have been prevented? Tell me in the comments!
